_comment: Season 1 calendar (docs/DISCORD_AND_COMMUNITY.md 6), read by consortium_calendar.js at ServerEvents.loaded. Every slot is at 20:00 server time (CONSORTIUM_SLOT_HOUR, never moved here). slots: the weekly Wednesday, Friday and Saturday slots by weekday; dates: pre-planned dates (a date entry overrides the slot of its weekday; staff-set dates in persistent state win over this file). Reward tokens {kill} {max} {bounty} {share} are filled at post time from the events engine's constants for the current phase. The two dates below are PLACEHOLDER examples (a Saturday programme and a cancelled Saturday) that the maintainer replaces with the real launch calendar; role_mention is an optional Discord role id rendered as <@&id> (rendering through the SDLink API is UNVERIFIED).

friday.title: Friday Zone
friday.rewards: {kill} per kill, {max} max, then the auditor bounty ({bounty}) and the Board's crate

2026-10-03.title: Boss Hunt
2026-10-03.rewards: {bounty} bounty shared by damage, {share} max per hunter
